content.short: DeWork is a web3-native project management tool, bounty platform, and professional network.
content.description: DeWork is a web browser dApp that enables collaboration, discovery of grants and bounties, and networking with other crypto natives. By aggregating grants and bounties from more than 500 DAOs into a single app, it makes bounty hunting and earning rewards easier for developers. It also provides a Trello-style collaborative productivity board to support smooth contributor cooperation across DAOs. If you're a developer seeking grants or a community dev looking for solutions for contributor coordination, DeWork is a solid option.
